title: HITL dogfood: Limatus on published Pilobolus
description:
# HITL dogfood: Limatus on published Pilobolus

## Intent

As Ryan, I want Limatus (scan + OpenAI judge + options + compare) to copy-edit every published Pilobolus article. The **agent** handles finding-level skip/rewrite from the house voice profile and VOICE.md. I steer by picking among ranked options and commenting on the *feel* of the piece. I do not micro-manage rubric heuristics.

## Loop

scan (always-lane ∪ OpenAI Terra judge) → **agent** records skip/rewrite/delete/keep/add from voice → options for rewrite only → compare shortlist → **human** chooses option and/or comments → apply to working copy → human publish.

## Guardrails

- Source: latest Pilobol.us `origin/main` `web/content/articles/*.md` (not index).
- Profile: Papyrus `publications/pilobolus/style-profile.yml` with `judge.provider: openai` (Terra default).
- Scan does not invent decisions. The copy-editing agent does. The human does not sit on every finding id.
- Working copies change only after an explicit human-chosen apply. No auto-publish.

## Out of scope

Newsroom UI. Auto-apply compare winners. Detector-score optimization. Unattended whole-document rewrite.

Title and standfirst are a **final** pass, not part of the first body scan.

Body HITL first (scan with YAML masked → decide → options → compare → apply on a working copy). Headline/dek only after that working copy’s body has settled, so the title matches the article we actually have. Tracked as LIM-565ba8.
